prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
competitors_mentioned: AI marketing agency in Los Angeles
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you want a big firm or a small specialist. I can help you pick the best fit. A few quick questions:

- What outcome do you want from AI marketing? (e.g., paid-media optimization, personalization, creative generation, predictive lead scoring, customer journey automation, chatbots)
- What’s your monthly/annual budget range?
- Do you prefer a large global agency or a boutique/tech-focused shop?
- What industry are you in (B2B, DTC, entertainment, healthcare, etc.)?
- Timeframe for results / project length?

If you want a fast starting point, agencies with established AI/data-driven marketing practices that serve LA clients include:
- R/GA — strong at data-driven creative, product and platform work.
- AKQA — known for digital innovation and experience design using advanced tech.
- Merkle — data-driven customer experience, analytics and CRM/AI personalization.
- Epsilon (part of Publicis) — heavy on data, personalization, and programmatic.
- Wpromote — performance marketing with automation/AI-driven optimization (LA-area HQ).

What I can do next:
- If you tell me your priorities and budget, I’ll produce a short, vetted shortlist (3–5 agencies) with why each fits, sample case studies, estimated costs, and recommended questions to ask them.
- Or I can draft an RFP you can send to agencies to evaluate proposals.

Which option would you like?
